source.description:
## Problem

The xtrm agent instruction top-templates (`.xtrm/config/instructions/{agents,claude}-top.md`) are the ONLY xtrm-managed context that did NOT migrate to the global asset model in the xtrm-bq7yd epic. Current flow:

- **Source**: npm-installed package `<pkg>/.xtrm/config/instructions/*.md` (or dev-checkout via npm link)
- **Injection**: `cli/src/commands/init.ts:injectProjectInstructionHeaders` reads templates, upserts marker-delimited block into per-project `CLAUDE.md` + `AGENTS.md` at `xt init` / `xt update --apply` time
- **Runtime**: static per-project rendered file, native Claude/Pi read at session start
- **Update propagation**: MANUAL per repo — every consumer must run `xt update --apply` to pick up template changes

Consequences observed:
- Fleet drift: consumer repos on this machine have -top blocks from various xtrm versions
- `upsertManagedBlock` merge logic in init.ts is fiddly (~90 lines, greedy vs lazy regex, marker-collision edge cases documented in memory `upsertmanagedblock-in-cli-src-commands-init-ts-use`)
- Two independent managed blocks in CLAUDE.md (xtrm + BEADS INTEGRATION from `bd setup claude`) — mix + collision surface
- Asymmetric with skills (~/.xtrm/skills/default/, global) + hooks (~/.xtrm/hooks/, global) which DO propagate live

## Design

Move -top files to the global asset model. Runtime-inject on both runtimes.

**Source**: `~/.xtrm/config/instructions/{agents,claude}-top.md` (canonical global; bootstrapped on `xt install` like ~/.xtrm/hooks/ was).

**Claude injection**:
- New hook `.xtrm/hooks/xtrm-instructions-reminder.mjs` (mirrors `using-xtrm-reminder.mjs` shape).
- Wired to `SessionStart` (fresh session inject) + `PreCompact` (re-inject after context compaction loses systemPrompt).
- Returns `hookSpecificOutput.additionalSystemPrompt` containing the claude-top.md body (frontmatter stripped).

**Pi injection**:
- Extend `packages/pi-extensions/extensions/xtrm-loader/index.ts before_agent_start` to read `~/.xtrm/config/instructions/agents-top.md` and prepend to systemPrompt alongside `.xtrm/memory.md`.

**Deprecate per-project marker block**:
- `injectProjectInstructionHeaders` becomes a no-op (or is deleted) — no more writes to consumer CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md.
- New `xt migrate instructions --apply` command: surgically remove existing `<!-- xtrm:start -->…<!-- xtrm:end -->` block from consumer CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md. Idempotent, marker-scoped.
- Consumer per-repo user content stays untouched.

**Per-repo override slot** (new): `.xtrm/config/instructions/*.override.md` in the consumer repo. If present, appended after the global body. Solves the current escape hatch (edit outside marker block).

## Blast radius (per gitnexus_impact model)

- `cli/src/commands/init.ts`: delete `injectProjectInstructionHeaders` + call site (~50 lines removed)
- `cli/src/core/global-assets-bootstrap.ts` (new? or extend existing): bootstrap `~/.xtrm/config/instructions/` from package on `xt install`
- New: `.xtrm/hooks/xtrm-instructions-reminder.mjs`
- `.xtrm/config/hooks.json`: wire the new hook for SessionStart + PreCompact
- Extend `packages/pi-extensions/extensions/xtrm-loader/index.ts`: add -top inject
- New: `cli/src/commands/migrate.ts` (or extend existing migrate command) — `xt migrate instructions --apply`
- Tests: 10-15 new (bootstrap, hook fires, xtrm-loader inject, override slot, marker cleanup migrate)
- Docs: `docs/instructions-runtime-inject.md` (new) + update `.xtrm/config/instructions/*.md` self-referential notes

Total ~200 LOC + tests.

## Test surface

- Bootstrap: fresh install populates `~/.xtrm/config/instructions/` from package
- Claude hook: SessionStart returns additionalSystemPrompt matching source
- Claude hook: PreCompact re-injects (returns additionalContext, not additionalSystemPrompt)
- Pi loader: appended to systemPrompt after memory.md
- Override slot: per-repo `.xtrm/config/instructions/*.override.md` appended after global body
- `xt migrate instructions --apply` removes only the marker block, preserves user content
- Idempotence: repeated migrate is no-op
- Fail-open: missing source file → hook returns undefined (does not crash)

## Migration path for existing consumers

1. Upgrade xtrm package → picks up new code path
2. `xt migrate instructions --apply` in each consumer repo → strips marker block
3. Next session starts → runtime hook injects the live global body

Optional: `xt update --apply` could auto-run the migrate step (with `--no-migrate-instructions` opt-out).

## Rollback

Revert commit. `injectProjectInstructionHeaders` is restored. Consumers who ran `xt migrate instructions --apply` need one `xt update --apply` to re-render the marker block.

## Alternative considered

Keep static render but symlink the source to `~/.xtrm/config/instructions/` — rejected because Claude Code caches CLAUDE.md aggressively and consumers still don't get updates without explicit action (some editor integrations reload on file change, most don't).

## Related

- Depends on / discovered-from: xtrm-bq7yd (global assets epic — this is the -top piece that was left out)
- Related: xtrm-8zsi1 (xtrm-loader hook shape reference)
- Related: xtrm-x12p3, xtrm-x12p3.1 (memory-processor + eager-load reduction — this is the -top instruction leg of the same story)
- Related: xtrm-0p7bp (settings.json hook reconcile pattern — same runtime-vs-static tradeoff we solved for hooks)

## Definition of done

- ~/.xtrm/config/instructions/ auto-bootstrapped on xt install
- Claude SessionStart + PreCompact hook injects live source
- Pi xtrm-loader injects live source (alongside .xtrm/memory.md)
- `xt migrate instructions --apply` strips consumer CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md marker blocks
- Per-repo override slot works
- Smoke: fresh session on Claude sees new -top content, on Pi too
- Fleet propagation verified: edit ~/.xtrm/config/instructions/*, next session both runtimes see it, zero `xt update` needed
- Docs updated
source.notes: Follow-up subsumption: implementing this bead makes `using-xtrm-reminder.mjs` (Claude SessionStart hook that eager-loads using-xtrm SKILL.md body) redundant — because PR #422 commit 8da33192 already folded using-xtrm's session-start reflex + trigger patterns into agents-top.md / claude-top.md. Once xtrm-148eh's runtime-inject of -top hits Claude, using-xtrm-reminder can be deleted from the SessionStart wiring. Add to DoD: remove using-xtrm-reminder.mjs from .xtrm/config/hooks.json + delete the script + strip using-xtrm-reminder tests. This closes the Claude-side asymmetry noted in claude-top.md's Project intelligence pointer section.
source.title: runtime-inject -top files instead of static per-project render
